analysis: The gated candidate ran successfully but failed the selection criterion: validation HR@10 was 0.645, unchanged from the prior candidate and 0.005 below the 0.650 incumbent. The host selected epoch 15 of 35. This result does not support retaining this variant or establish that selective contextual filtering improved ranking. Keep the incumbent; no test metrics were used.
code_summary: One causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional tied item embeddings, maximum length 128, and eight residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block expands conv1 to 128 channels, splits features and gates, and applies features * sigmoid(gates) before dropout. Gate weights and biases start at zero, giving initial gates of 0.5. Layer normalization, conv2, learned per-channel residual scales initialized to 0.1, left-only padding, padding masks, position-free embeddings, and last-nonpadding candidate scoring are preserved. Dropout=0.2, LR=0.001, weight decay=0.0, batch size=128; training and evaluation remain host-owned.
